description: Finds and replaces every occurrence of a string across the whole deck — shapes and table cells on slides, and their speaker notes (batchUpdate replaceAllText). Scope it with page_object_ids to touch only specific slides. Matching is literal (no regex), case-sensitive by default (match_case=false to ignore case). Returns occurrencesChanged in the reply — 0 means nothing matched, check the exact wording with list_slides. The classic template flow: duplicate a template deck, then replace {{placeholders}}.

find.description: The literal text to find (no regex).

page_object_ids.description: Limit the replacement to these slides/pages (default: the whole presentation).

presentation_id.description: The presentation id — the long id from the URL (docs.google.com/presentation/d/<presentationId>/edit) or from create_presentation output.

replace.description: The replacement text (empty string deletes the matches).

name: replace_text
title: Find & replace text
